title: Regression: build failure with platforms who do not have SONIC_ONE_IMAGE)_LAZY_INSTALLS in one-image.mk
author: nobutomonakano-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

mellanox

### Importance or Severity

High

### Previous Working Version

b17ed7305913d57c8f3e73e7330e021f11ea2516

### Steps to Reproduce

PR26731 breaks build for all platforms who don't have SONIC_ONE_IMAGE)_LAZY_INSTALLS in one-image.mk

\#files/build_templates/sonic_debian_extension.j2:888  — creates the dir ONLY inside this guard
  {% if lazy_installer_debs.strip() -%}                  # ← empty for Mellanox: one-image.mk has no _LAZY_INSTALLS
      sudo mkdir -p $FILESYSTEM_ROOT/$PLATFORM_DIR/common
  {% endif %}

In this PR we are doing

\# Rescan packages and update Packages index
dpkg-scanpackages $FS_ROOT/platform/common | gzip -c > $FS_ROOT/platform/common/Packages.gz

causing error

\+ dpkg-scanpackages ./fs********-mellanox/platform/common
01:27:34  + gzip -c
01:27:34  ./scripts/signing_secure_boot_dev.sh: line 136: ./fs********-nvidia-bluefield/platform/common/Packages.gz: No such file or directory
01:27:34  dpkg-scanpackages: error: binary path ./fs********-nvidia-bluefield/platform/common not found



### Impact of this regression

build failure for all platforms who don't have SONIC_ONE_IMAGE)_LAZY_INSTALLS in one-image.mk
